name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: One staggered enter/exit text animator: fade, slide, blur, scale, mask and tracking effects over character, word, line or block units, with 14 classic looks as presets.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/text-reveal?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
